results.title: Ghana’s 24-Hour/New Economy: Why warehouse efficiency must drive productivity and supply chain resilience
results.content: Ghana's 24-hour/New Economy initiative presents an opportunity to boost industrial productivity, create employment, and strengthen the country's competitiveness whether private sector or government led. However, its success will depend not only on how long businesses operate, but also on how efficiently they manage the chains of production, stock, warehousing, and distribution, which are inseparably linked.

results.title: Adequate funding needed for NCCE to fulfil its mandate – Agalga
results.content: Majority Leader and Chairman of Parliament's Committee on Independent Constitutional Bodies, James Agalga, has called for adequate funding for the National Commission for Civic Education (NCCE), warning that the gap between its operational needs and available resources could affect its ability to carry out its constitutional responsibilities.

results.content: The prestigious competition attracted approximately 140 amateur golfers, including international competitors from Nigeria, Burundi and Kenya, highlighting the tournament’s growing appeal beyond Ghana.

results.title: Sports Ministry congratulates Black Challenge on amputee football World Cup victory
results.content: The Ministry of Sports and Recreation has congratulated the Black Challenge on winning the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico.

results.title: Thousands travel to COP. One Ghanaian journalist follows the negotiations from home
results.content: For about seven years, Mahmud Mohammed-Nurudeen has followed the United Nations climate conferences from Ghana, examining the documents, decisions and political arguments that shape the response to climate change.

results.title: Ghana must mobilise more domestic capital to finance economic growth – Stanbic’s Kwamina Asomaning
results.content: Ghana must strengthen its capacity to mobilise domestic capital to finance economic growth and reduce its exposure to external financial shocks, Kwamina Asomaning, President of the Ghana Association of Banks and Chief Executive of Stanbic Bank Ghana, said.

results.title: Ghana, UK target terrorism, cybercrime and fraud at London security talks
results.content: Ghana and the United Kingdom will seek to strengthen cooperation on terrorism, cybercrime, fraud and other shared threats at the fourth UK-Ghana Security Dialogue, scheduled to begin in London today, November 23.

results.title: Shippers’ Authority targets shipping charges, tougher enforcement in 2027
results.content: The Ghana Shippers’ Authority (GSA) is prioritising tighter oversight of shipping charges, stronger enforcement, and faster complaint resolution in 2027 as it works to deliver on its expanded regulatory mandate.

results.title: Kpebu challenges NACOC over suspects’ two-month detention in cocaine case
results.content: Private legal practitioner Martin Kpebu has accused the Narcotics Control Commission (NACOC) of violating the rights of suspects held in connection with a 3.9-tonne cocaine seizure in France.

results.title: GES recruitment portal set to open today after technical delay
results.content: The Ghana Education Service (GES) recruitment portal is expected to open today, Monday, November 23, after technical difficulties delayed its scheduled launch.

results.title: From selling fried yam to GCB: Naa Abeka Nunoo shares her journey
results.content: Digital marketing and public relations professional Naa Abeka Nunoo has shared how selling fried yam after secondary school became the starting point of a career that would eventually take her to GCB.

results.title: Ghana armwrestling referees earn world promotions
results.content: Three Ghanaian referees have earned prestigious international promotions following their performances at the just-ended World Armwrestling Championship in India, marking another significant stride for Ghana and African armwrestling. Husseini Akueteh Addy, Nii Otoo Larkyn and Abigail Frema earned promotions within the World Armwrestling refereeing hierarchy after successfully officiating a combined 209 matches at the championship. Their promotions recognise their dedication, competence, technical expertise, commitment to the sport and ability to operate at the highest level of international competition.

results.title: Plastic-choked beaches: Coastal livelihoods under threat
results.content: Towering drifts of crushed water sachets, bleached single-use grocery bags, tangled heaps of monofilament fishing nets, and sun-faded plastic bottles stretch along the seashore as far as the eye can see.

results.title: Efya makes first public appearance after marriage
results.content: Ghanaian songstress Efya made her first public appearance since marrying Nigerian musician Tomi Thomas, gracing the 5th anniversary celebration of Shapes By Nelson last Tuesday.

results.title: Art against antimicrobial resistance: How Techiman is using creativity to fight drug resistance
results.content: The Techiman Public Library has been transformed into a vibrant canvas of hope and health this week, as Art Against AMR Ghana brings together students, traders, health workers, and traditional leaders for World AMR Awareness Week 2026.

results.title: Vice President urges protection of children from hazardous work
results.content: President Professor Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang has called for collective and concerted efforts towards protecting children from exploitative labour in the nation’s fishing industry.

results.title: Abena Osei-Asare calls for citizens’ support in fight against corruption
results.content: The Chairperson of Parliament’s Public Accounts Committee and Member of Parliament for Atiwa East, Abena Osei-Asare, has called on Ghanaians to take greater responsibility in the fight against corruption, insisting that efforts to promote integrity in public office must begin with a change in societal attitudes.

results.title: BoG pushes for cheaper cross-border payments at Singapore finance meetings
results.content: The Bank of Ghana (BoG) has called for a more targeted approach to improving cross-border payments in Africa, focusing on reducing costs and making transactions more reliable for businesses and households.

results.title: David Quao elected NDC UK & Ireland chairman, pledges to unite chapter
results.content: David Quao has been elected Chairman of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) UK & Ireland Chapter, pledging to bridge divisions and serve all members after the party’s internal elections.

results.title: BoG rate cut lowers banks’ borrowing costs, but tighter corridor could lift market rates
results.content: Commercial banks will pay less to borrow overnight from the Bank of Ghana after its latest policy rate cut. However, a narrower policy corridor could push short-term market rates higher from their recent levels.
